title: finding(plugin-audit): `sys_comment.reactions` is described as "JSON array of emoji reaction objects", but its one reader and writer stores `{ emoji: userIds[] }`
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with a named site, class (b), a declared text that contradicts the stored shape. `reach:` named real producer: objectui's `RecordDetailView`, the only in-tree reader and writer of `sys_comment.reactions`, stores a map. Reader: triage first (grade and route; the fix lands in `packages/plugins/plugin-audit`). Filed by the objectui `domain:ui` seat 2, `session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`, from the dev's out-of-scope finding on PR objectstack-ai/objectui#11034 (objectstack-ai/objectui#11019). ⛔ Not graded here.

## The declaration (objectstack `origin/main` `288611e3`)

`packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-comment.object.ts`, the `reactions` field:

```ts
reactions: Field.textarea({
  label: 'Reactions',
  required: false,
  description: 'JSON array of emoji reaction objects',
  group: 'Body',
}),
```

The four `*.objects.generated.ts` translation files carry a `reactions` entry beside it.

## What is stored

- objectui `RecordDetailView` parses `sys_comment.reactions` as a JSON object `{ emoji: userIds[] }` and writes the same shape back on a reaction click (objectstack-ai/objectui#11019 keeps each emoji's user ids in it).
- No producer in either repository writes the array shape the description names. The objectui PR's dev read this; a producer following the description would write an array, and the objectui read would then show index keys with a count of 0. That last step is read inference, not probed.

## Why it matters

The field description is metadata served to authors and to AI (NORTH-STAR 优先级 rule 4: a sentence written for AI that says the wrong thing is a product defect). An agent seeding comments from this description writes a shape the only reader cannot use.

## Direction (for triage)

- The description follows the stored shape, `JSON object mapping each emoji to the list of user ids who reacted`, and the generated translations are regenerated with it. (Implementation-first: the one producer and reader agree on the map.)
- Whether the same sentence form on `mentions` (`JSON array of @mention objects`) is right was NOT measured and is not claimed here.

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated objectstack issues and PRs (open and closed, down to #8753) were listed through REST and grepped locally, read 2026-09-29: `sys_comment` near `reactions`, 0 hits; control `reaction` alone, 4 hits (none about this field). In objectui, the same query hits only objectstack-ai/objectui#11019 and its PRs, which change the objectui side only.

Dedupe words: `sys_comment` reactions description · reactions JSON array emoji objects · `sys_comment` reactions shape · reactions userIds map

<sub>objectui `domain:ui` seat 2 · finding · 2026-09-29</sub>
